name: v213_daemon_validation
description: v1.5.9 instruction 213 H7-H10 daemon mode + adversarial transition validation plan. Three adversarial entries (AUTH_OR_LAUNCH_FAILED via nonexistent CLI; FAILED terminal via worker emitting terminal --status FAILED; stall detection via STARTING then sleep) + one happy-path subagent + one happy-path cross-CLI claude. Captures end-to-end daemon mode coverage for the Phase 1 ship gate.

runs.name: h7_auth_or_launch_failed_nonexistent_cli
runs.purpose: H7 transition #4 adversarial trigger: cli_command 'nonexistent-qpb-cli' produces no STARTUP heartbeat within 60 sec post-dispatch. Next tick marks state=failed, failure_subtype=AUTH_OR_LAUNCH_FAILED. Captures worker_prompt content, claimed/job-NNNNN.lock content if PID capturable, harness_status.json failure_subtype.

runs.name: h8_failed_terminal_status
runs.purpose: H8 transition #2 adversarial trigger: worker prompt invokes qpb_heartbeat.py terminal --status FAILED. Next tick moves manifest to results/ with state=failed, result_file populated, no failure_subtype (failure is intentional, not transitional). Captures heartbeat.ndjson tail, result-NNNNN.json, harness_status.json.
runs.worker_prompt_override:
You are a synthetic adversarial worker for QPB instruction 213 H8. Your single job: emit a STARTING heartbeat then immediately a terminal --status FAILED. Do NOT run any real work. Use the env vars in the prompt header for QPB_TASK_ID and QPB_HEARTBEAT_PATH.

Step 1:
  python3 -m bin.qpb_heartbeat emit --phase 'Phase 1' --step 'h8-start' --status STARTING

Step 2:
  python3 -m bin.qpb_heartbeat terminal --status FAILED --result-file /tmp/h8-no-result --summary 'intentional failure for H8 test'

Then return a one-line summary string. Do not echo heartbeat content.

expect.note: Worker emitted terminal --status FAILED voluntarily; this is transition #2 in STATE_MACHINE.md, not #4 or #6.

runs.name: h9_stall_detection_starting_then_sleep
runs.purpose: H9 transition #3 adversarial trigger: worker prompt emits ONE STARTING heartbeat then sleeps. Plan's stall_threshold_minutes=1 + early_warn_minutes=0.5 give a manageable validation window. After dispatch + 60 sec next tick should mark stalled (early_warn). After dispatch + 90 sec past 1-min stall threshold the next tick marks failed with failure_subtype=STALLED. May be deferred per § Done definition.
runs.worker_prompt_override:
You are a synthetic adversarial worker for QPB instruction 213 H9. Your single job: emit a STARTING heartbeat then sleep 300 sec without emitting any further heartbeats. Use the env vars in the prompt header for QPB_TASK_ID and QPB_HEARTBEAT_PATH.

Step 1:
  python3 -m bin.qpb_heartbeat emit --phase 'Phase 1' --step 'h9-start' --status STARTING

Step 2:
  sleep 300

This worker is expected to be marked STALLED by the harness's next tick after stall_threshold_minutes elapses.

runs.name: h10_happy_path_subagent
runs.purpose: H10 end-to-end happy path: one subagent worker that emits STARTING, runs a trivial in-context check, then emits terminal --status COMPLETED. Validates the full daemon lifecycle: daemon spawn, automated tick firing, worker completion, harness reconciliation, done.marker write, daemon clean exit, PID file removal.
runs.worker_prompt_override:
You are a synthetic happy-path worker for QPB instruction 213 H10. Emit STARTING, then a single IN_PROGRESS, then terminal COMPLETED. Use the env vars in the prompt header.

Step 1: STARTING heartbeat for 'Phase 1'.
Step 2: IN_PROGRESS heartbeat for 'Phase 1, step probe'.
Step 3: terminal --status COMPLETED with --result-file /tmp/h10-synthetic-result --summary 'h10 happy-path probe ok'.

Return a one-line summary. Total wall time should be < 30 sec.

runs.name: h10_happy_path_cross_cli_claude
runs.purpose: H10 end-to-end happy path: cross-CLI shell-out to a separate `claude --print` instance running the same trivial worker. Validates the B-1 two-probe pre-flight (--version + --print 'echo ok' roundtrip) against a known-working CLI, then the full daemon lifecycle for a cross-CLI worker.
runs.worker_prompt_override:
You are a synthetic happy-path cross-CLI worker for QPB instruction 213 H10. Same shape as the subagent variant: STARTING -> IN_PROGRESS -> terminal COMPLETED. Use the env vars in the prompt header.

Return a one-line summary. Wall time should be < 60 sec.
